scope: Extend the new law to an explicit local conditional background and verify it on larger synthetic frames only. No real-record responses, fitting or simulator.
basis: The exact complete-cohort<=3 law normalizes, but real training frames contain hundreds of vehicles. A conditional boundary is necessary before any real-record likelihood claim.
selected_boundary: Outside a current-state-selected stochastic set J, fix current latent intent realization, residual0, start/yield permissions True and LC stay. Keep all those actors physically present and recompute their accepted responses in every latent branch. This is an explicit conditional intervention/working law, not the whole-world shared-randomness model.
stochastic_set: Choose focal plus all current geometry/one-second reach-envelope actors able to interact with its adjacent-lane landing envelope, using current positions, lengths, gaps, allowed speeds and v+a/finite-path reach only. No native future, observed label or posthoc direct-denier identity. Include every actor required by the registered rule; if its size exceeds the declared exact-enumeration limit, report the full required set and obstruction instead of truncating.
implementation: Separate complete physical frame from stochastic/LC participant set; the whole physical frame may exceed3 while J remains bounded.
Shared coefficients apply to all actors in J; outside values are conditioned quantities. New receiving-road intents within J must be integrated, not randomly sampled or replaced by a legal union.

Use the same full priority forward resolver and complete projected background when checking each stochastic LC action. Background endpoints must respond to local branch changes rather than freezing their future positions.
Reject the whole input if any positive-mass branch is outside its registered geometry/intent/body-remap domain; no dropped branch or mass renormalization.
verification: A few fixed synthetic frames with4-8 current actors: distant background, binding body/receiving background, branch-dependent background response, local LC and component overflow. Check latent/event/observation normalization and input/RNG isolation.
decision: Produce a bounded conditional-law prototype and report its exact conditioning, computational cost and remaining domain limits. Do not claim full160000-record support or control/source-transfer benefit.
after: Stop after synthetic conditional-boundary verification. Any small real-state panel or full reservoir readout and any future fitting require a separately specified budget.
